verdict.rationale: Superset has a first-class task system that can be created, triaged and managed via the SDK, MCP server and CLI, and each task runs in its own worktree and branch with an agent. A community comment also implies a Linear integration exists on paid plans. No documentation shows a flow that turns an existing issue or ticket (Linear, GitHub Issues, Jira) directly into an agent assignment. Missing for 10: first-party docs on issue-tracker integrations (Linear/GitHub/Jira), a documented one-click 'start agent from issue' flow, and hands-on corroboration that ticket context passes to the agent.
